title: Qman DirectPath signed pre-run QualificationRunRequest
description: Closed TEST_EVIDENCE-signed request created before a physical qualification run. It fixes the one-time nonce, target, current host generation, intended platform/backend, workload and requested Case set without referring to any object produced by the run.
x-qmanTargetAndHostRule: Normalize targetRepositoryCommit to the lowercase unprefixed Git object ID C. Resolve mappingCoreId/mappingCoreDigest as the one detached mapping core M for C and verify portableContractSha256 against the independently pinned portable contract. At signing and again during atomic run admission, independently read the current HostAuthority and require hostId, hostEpoch, kernelBootId and currentSnapshotContentHash to equal hostId, hostEpoch, bootId and currentInventorySnapshotDigest. Resolve deviceRecordHash as exactly one schema-valid DeviceRecord named by that current HostSnapshot, require its deviceUid to equal deviceUid, and freeze this exact-device tuple before any collector or Case executes. Independently derive platformProfileDigest from the active compatibility-policy row selected by platformProfileId, and resolve backendProfileDigest to the complete intended kernel/QEMU/firmware/backend runtime projection whose backendFamily and configuredIommuType equal this request. A mutable branch/tag, stale inventory pointer, host epoch/boot change, device substitution, alternate map or profile/backend relabeling invalidates the request before any collector is run.
x-qmanQualificationPlanRule: Resolve workloadDefinition.path inside evidence commit E, verify exact raw sha256/byteLength/application-json media type, validate only against the fixed QualificationWorkloadDefinition schema whose raw hash equals schemaSha256, and verify definitionDigest plus its TEST_EVIDENCE signature. Parsed workloadId/definitionDigest/minimumDurationSeconds MUST equal workloadId/workloadDefinitionDigest/minimumDurationSeconds; entrypoint/config, required artifact roles, mandatory assertion digests and metric definitions are then authoritative and cannot be supplied by the result reporter. requestedCaseIds is canonical and MUST equal the complete independently derived Case plan applicable to this physical qualification request, including transitive Case dependencies; it is never a reporter-selected subset. The consuming QualificationRunManifest, all QualificationMeasurements, scenario inputs and eventual QualificationSubjectManifest MUST byte-equal this request's qualificationRunId, C/M, host generation, snapshot, platform/backend and workload bindings, and the manifest's core/measurement graph MUST cover exactly this requested Case set.
x-qmanNonceAndFreshnessRule: Decode requestNonce as unpadded base64url and require at least 128 bits generated by a cryptographically secure orchestrator RNG before signing; a nonce copied from target code, an evidence repository or another request is invalid. The run-admission authority atomically consumes the unique tuple [orchestratorPrincipalId,requestNonce] and binds it to exactly requestId/qualificationRunId before the first side effect. Reuse with another request or run, a failed compare-and-swap, or retry after consumption is denied; retry requires a new requestId, qualificationRunId and nonce. issuedAt is strictly before expiresAt, verifier time is within that interval at admission, and the complete run must remain inside the signed interval. The interval is bounded by the independently configured qualification policy and is long enough for minimumDurationSeconds; extending it requires a new signed request rather than mutation.
x-qmanAcyclicConstructionRule: This request is constructed and signed before the run. It contains qualificationRunId as a correlation identifier but contains no QualificationRunManifest path/hash/runDigest, QualificationMeasurement descriptor/digest, scenario execution-core or ExecutionEvidenceIndex digest, QualificationSubjectManifest digest, QualificationRecord digest, CaseCompletionRecord digest or release-index digest. Later measurements may bind qualificationRunId and this request as immutable input evidence; the completed RunManifest may bind this request's raw hash/requestDigest and exact projection; later Subject/Index/Record objects may then refer forward. No later object is inserted into requestDigest, so no fixed point or backward evidence edge exists.
x-qmanDigestAndSignatureRule: Deep-copy the complete closed request, conceptually replace requestDigest and signature with null, retain every other field unchanged, serialize with RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), and store SHA-256 of those UTF-8 bytes in requestDigest. The null/null construction projection need not validate as a stored signed instance. Verify signature as Ed25519 over ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/QUALIFICATION-RUN-REQUEST/V1) || 0x00 || the same JCS bytes. Resolve signerKeyId through the independently authenticated key ring at keyRingVersion; the key is active and non-revoked at issuedAt, has role TEST_EVIDENCE, and its immutable principalId byte-equals orchestratorPrincipalId. A signature over ordinary JSON, a different canonicalization/domain, an unsigned field projection, a self-declared role or a key controlled by another principal is invalid.
